purpose: convert the reproduced semantic-off nested-OOF policy into one target-blind deployable artifact without changing the algorithm
unique_variable: fold-specific model/threshold policy to one full-data ranker, two full-data admission heads, and quantile-mapped threshold

ranker.reuse_reason: the model was already trained once from the same frozen feature/label cache, config, seed, and median outer-fold round rule; retraining would violate the one-full-model boundary

admission.head_training_surface: all action rows generated by semantic-off outer-OOF ranker scores
admission.head_training_reason: OOF stacking prevents in-sample full-ranker confidence leakage
admission.runtime_inputs: visible query, causal session history, candidate metadata, ranker scores, and target-blind derived features only

nested_quantile_protocol.quantile_grid: 0/64 through 63/64 using NumPy method=higher, plus KEEP
nested_quantile_protocol.per_outer_fold_selection: inner-OOF utilities only; require aggregate and every inner fold hit_to_miss=0, MRR delta>=0, MTTC delta<=0; maximize TechnicalScore, net hits, positive inner folds, then minimize activations and prefer the higher quantile
nested_quantile_protocol.outer_threshold_mapping: map the selected fold quantile to the outer-trained heads' unlabeled outer-train action-utility distribution before scoring the held fold
nested_quantile_protocol.final_quantile_rule: median of the five inner-selected outer-fold quantiles
nested_quantile_protocol.final_threshold_mapping: map the frozen median quantile to the final heads' utility distribution on unlabeled full-ranker train_explore action rows using method=higher

decision_rule: if any gate fails, record ARTIFACT_FREEZE_NO_GO and do not integrate or open held-out data
